A chaotic human Wizard loads the source temple, reads the wished blessed teleport scroll from the C-observed inventory slot o, uses getpos background-symbol search for the altar, wishes a human corpse on that square, and confirms #offer. The counted C path must show the altar-staining call to priest.c:angry_priest and the chaotic alignment branch without v29's later angrygods caller; preserve only if C proves it reached the shrine, accepted the corpse, and changed the priest state.
